description: The 6 valid Workday supplier groups. Two jobs: assignment='selectable' lists what AP may pick as the one extra group; assignment='auto_band' rows carry the first_char_from/first_char_to boundaries a transform bands the supplier name with (is_fallback='Y' when the first character is outside every band). The band boundaries live here, in config, so they are not hard-coded in a CASE the way workday_supplier_groups.sql does it. Same shape as ref_customer_group.
provenance: Transcribed 2026-10-12 from the Supplier EIB's Default_Supplier_Group named range ('Customer Specific Named Ranges'!C/D, `/Users/Rakesh.Patel/Documents/__data/excel/threeplus/CCS/FA E2E Suppliers V1.xlsm`). A snapshot, not a link. Band rows first, then the 3 selectable rows together (an Excel range must be contiguous). The migration used 'Barclays Girls Football Schools Partnerships' as the extra group on all 319 suppliers; 'Panel Members' and 'Referees' are valid and unused by it.
